fusions.name: Palmed Coin
fusions.desc: Flicks a palmed coin that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets, with a 20% chance to confuse it for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Picked Pockets
fusions.desc: Lifts every affliction off the target at once for 20 damage, adding 1.6 times the afflictions' remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Now You See Me
fusions.desc: A flourish of the fingers draws every eye away: you are veiled for 6 seconds and move 15% faster. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Lifted Trinket
fusions.desc: Conjures a trinket lifted from someone's purse: your critical chance rises by 6%, your critical hits deal 0.15x more, and each kill returns 3 health.
